---
title: "1 Kings"
---

# 1 Kings

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

1 Kings records Solomon's reign, the construction of the Temple, and the division of Israel into two kingdoms. The book teaches that covenant faithfulness leads to blessing, while idolatry brings decline and judgment.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 1:30</div>

<div class="identifier">Solomon shall reign after me</div>

### Why This Verse

Succession settled

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the transition of power from David to Solomon. The key verse highlights God's preservation of His covenant plan through Solomon's succession.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 2:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Keep the charge of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

David's final counsel

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains David's final instructions and Solomon's consolidation of the kingdom. The key verse emphasizes obedience to God's law as the foundation of successful leadership.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 3:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Give thy servant an understanding heart</div>

### Why This Verse

Solomon's famous request

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Solomon's request for wisdom. The key verse demonstrates that true leadership begins with dependence upon God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 4:29</div>

<div class="identifier">God gave Solomon wisdom</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of Solomon's gift

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Solomon's administration and prosperity. The key verse highlights the peace and abundance that accompanied wise rule.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 5:5</div>

<div class="identifier">I purpose to build a house unto the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Temple project begins

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records preparations for building the Temple. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises to David.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 6:7</div>

<div class="identifier">No hammer heard in the temple</div>

### Why This Verse

Memorable temple detail

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details the construction of the Temple. The key verse underscores God's desire to dwell among His covenant people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 7:51</div>

<div class="identifier">All the work was finished</div>

### Why This Verse

Temple completion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the completion of Solomon's palace and Temple furnishings. The key verse highlights the excellence devoted to God's house.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 8:27</div>

<div class="identifier">Will God indeed dwell on the earth?</div>

### Why This Verse

Solomon's temple prayer

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the dedication of the Temple. The key verse celebrates God's presence dwelling among His people while recognizing His infinite greatness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 9:3</div>

<div class="identifier">My eyes and My heart shall be there perpetually</div>

### Why This Verse

God's response

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts God's appearance to Solomon after the Temple's completion. The key verse emphasizes that covenant blessing depends upon continued obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 10:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Blessed be the LORD thy God</div>

### Why This Verse

Queen of Sheba's testimony

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the visit of the Queen of Sheba. The key verse demonstrates how God's blessing upon Solomon became a witness to the nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 11:4</div>

<div class="identifier">His heart was not fully devoted</div>

### Why This Verse

Solomon's decline

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Solomon's spiritual decline through idolatry. The key verse reveals the danger of divided devotion to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 12:16</div>

<div class="identifier">What portion have we in David?</div>

### Why This Verse

Division of the kingdom

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the division of the kingdom under Rehoboam. The key verse illustrates how pride and poor counsel can fracture unity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 13:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou hast disobeyed the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Judgment on the prophet

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the ministry of the man of God from Judah. The key verse emphasizes complete obedience to God's word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 14:8</div>

<div class="identifier">David followed Me with all his heart</div>

### Why This Verse

David as standard

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records judgment upon Jeroboam and Rehoboam. The key verse highlights the consequences of persistent sin and idolatry.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 15:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Asa did what was right</div>

### Why This Verse

Righteous king summary

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts faithful and unfaithful kings. The key verse commends Asa's wholehearted devotion to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 16:30</div>

<div class="identifier">Ahab did evil above all before him</div>

### Why This Verse

Introduction to Ahab

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes political instability and increasing wickedness in Israel. The key verse introduces Ahab as one of Israel's most evil kings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 17:1</div>

<div class="identifier">There shall not be dew nor rain</div>

### Why This Verse

Elijah's first appearance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins Elijah's ministry. The key verse demonstrates God's power to provide during times of judgment and scarcity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 18:21</div>

<div class="identifier">How long halt ye between two opinions?</div>

### Why This Verse

Elijah at Carmel

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Elijah's confrontation with the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel. The key verse calls God's people to wholehearted allegiance to Him alone.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 19:12</div>

<div class="identifier">A still small voice</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most famous OT verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Elijah's discouragement and God's restoration of him. The key verse reveals God's presence through a gentle whisper rather than dramatic displays alone.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 20:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Let not him that girds on boast</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous proverb-like statement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes God's victories over Syria through Ahab. The key verse demonstrates that God's glory is His ultimate purpose.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 21:25</div>

<div class="identifier">None like Ahab sold himself to do evil</div>

### Why This Verse

Ahab's legacy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Ahab's seizure of Naboth's vineyard. The key verse highlights God's commitment to justice against abuse of power.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">1 Kings 22:14</div>

<div class="identifier">What the LORD says unto me, that will I speak</div>

### Why This Verse

Micaiah's integrity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Micaiah's prophecy and Ahab's death. The key verse demonstrates that God's word is certain even when rejected.
:::
